job: Turn each prepared version-two RFQ into one locally generated, verifiable JSON artifact package containing the exact RFQ, a standalone quantity schedule, and a real vector drawing-set PDF, all bound by a manifest and checksums.

outputs.acceptance: The package carries the validated version-two RFQ, its schedule, assumptions, exclusions, response template, design/budget/RFQ hashes, quantity schedule, drawing PDF and an exact artifact manifest.
The reader rejects future versions, stale project/budget inputs, malformed PDF bytes, changed artifact content, incorrect byte counts or SHA-256 values, manifest drift and package-hash mismatch.
A prepared RFQ exposes a clearly labelled complete-package download. Nothing is generated before the press and nothing is sent or uploaded.

dependsOn.evidence: Version-two hash-bound comparable RFQs are implemented and served.
The project already has deterministic SVG drawings, a vector PDF writer and professional handoff contracts; the RFQ surface does not yet assemble them.

rejectionGates: Reject if any landing-scene, Three.js, animation, model, meadow, tree, sky, mountain, shader, camera, lighting, builder geometry, plan catalog, GLB or generated-plan asset changes.
Reject if package generation reads a clock, randomness or live project state not already bound by the RFQ; the RFQ createdAtISO is the reproducible issue time.
Reject if a version-one RFQ, mismatched project id/design hash, or changed budget hash can produce a current package.
Reject if the PDF is a placeholder, raster screenshot or unverified filename; it must come from the existing vector drawing-set writer and carry the RFQ design hash.
Reject if any artifact content, byte length or SHA-256 can change without package verification failing, or if the manifest can disagree with the artifacts.
Reject if a package is generated automatically, sent, uploaded, emailed or used to contact a provider without the user's explicit download press.
Reject if any external provider, payment, legal, HOMES, deployment, outreach or infrastructure gate is crossed.

verify.freshContextVerifier: A verifier that did not implement Q04A must inspect the final stable snapshot when delegation is authorized.

anchors: The package contains exactly one validated RFQ JSON artifact, one quantity JSON artifact and one real PDF artifact beginning with %PDF-.
Every manifest SHA-256 and byte length is recomputed from its artifact content by the reader.
Changing one byte, one manifest entry, the RFQ, or the package hash is refused by name.
The browser download is absent until an RFQ exists and happens only after the user presses the complete-package control.
No changed path is under the frozen 3D, animation, model, meadow, worker, drawing-engine or plan-geometry sets.

repair.scope: Only Q04A package assembly, integrity verification, download UX or focused tests may be repaired. A second failure returns the node to blocked without touching frozen visual or geometry paths.

results: Production-export marketplace browser path: 6/6 passed, including a real downloaded package and embedded %PDF- payload.
Implementation commit contains only the four declared implementation/test paths and no frozen 3D, animation, model, meadow, worker, drawing-engine or builder-geometry path.
